rules: IDs, actor and received_at come from verified server context; never copy client reward fields.
Content fields required for learning events; null allowed only for global fidelity/privacy events with documented scope.
At least one attempt_id/activity_id required for instructional evidence.
Canonical name does not confer authority. Validate source, evidence and semantic uniqueness in C29.
Legacy missing fields remain unknown; do not invent sessions, confidence, concepts or unaided success.
preference_changed stays outside reward ledger. Fidelity and analytics cannot award.
Mastery transitions require delayed, separate-session, varied-form concept evidence; chapter mastery also requires coverage.
